title: Evidence for evolution; Unicellular organisms, multicellularity and life functions; Human impact and sustainability
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for CCEA A-level Biology (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: CE09#t2 term and clue written for the game; CE09#t3 term and clue written for the game; CE09#t4 term and clue written for the game; CE09#t1 term and clue written for the game. Questions: CE09#N.10, EC08#N.20, EV03a#N.3a, EV03a#N.5a.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Heterotroph
items.clue: An organism that takes in organic food made by other organisms

items.label: Autotroph
items.clue: An organism that makes its own organic molecules by photosynthesis

items.label: Paramecium
items.clue: Freshwater organism with cilia, an oral groove and contractile vacuoles

items.label: Protoctists
items.clue: Eukaryotic group, mostly unicellular, some showing only limited differentiation

questions.stem: Volvox is a green alga: a hollow ball of over a thousand cells. Most of its cells beat flagella to swim but never divide; a few large cells only make new colonies. Its close relative Chlamydomonas is a single cell that both swims and reproduces. What does Volvox gain from being multicellular?

options.text: It is more advanced: Chlamydomonas is a stage on the way to becoming multicellular.
Its cells specialise: swimming and reproducing are done by different cells.
Its cells could not live alone, because one cell cannot carry out every life process.
Each of its cells has the same abilities, so the colony simply does more of the same.

questions.stem: A grower controls glasshouse whitefly on tomatoes by releasing the wasp Encarsia formosa instead of spraying insecticide. Which statement is correct?

options.text: The wasps will keep attacking whitefly until none are left, so the grower will need to release them only once, ever.
An insecticide would have harmed only the whitefly, because sprays act only on the pest they are aimed at in a crop.
Adding any new species to a glasshouse benefits its ecosystem, so introducing a control agent can never carry any risk.
Encarsia attacks whitefly but not other insects, so the crop's pollinators are left unharmed.

questions.stem: Sharks, which are fish, and dolphins, which are mammals, both have streamlined bodies, a dorsal fin and paddle-shaped front fins. Which statement about these features is correct?

options.text: They are homologous, showing that dolphins are more closely related to sharks than they are to other mammals.
They are homologous, because in both animals the features perform the same function in water.
They show that the two species are converging on each other and will eventually merge into a single species.
They are analogous: they evolved separately because similar selection favoured similar shapes in water.

questions.stem: The amino acid sequence of the same protein was compared in four species. Compared with species W, species X differs at 2 positions, species Y at 15 positions and species Z at 31 positions. Which conclusion is supported by the data?

options.text: W shares a more recent common ancestor with X than it does with either Y or Z.
Z is the most primitive of the four species, because its sequence is furthest from W's.
X lives in the same kind of habitat as W, because similar conditions give similar proteins.
X is the ancestor of W, because the two sequences are almost identical.

questions.explanation: Differences accumulate after two lineages split. W and X differ least, so their common ancestor is the most recent.
